verdict.rationale: Agora is a real-time communications and voice-agent platform. Versioning or rolling back agent or workflow configurations is a plausible capability for it, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Related items such as certificate rotation, recording for review, and REST APIs are a different control or developer building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
